definition: Strict eligible observed sale contracts; land leasehold excluded; current canonical regions; transaction-weighted median
price_bins: 억원: lower inclusive, upper exclusive, fixed 0.5 bins; not confidence intervals
support: 40 contracts and 10 complexes per period; 10 values in each released bin and on both sides of each quantile; no 1-9 contract selection difference
rank_rule: Conservative possible ranks from released half-open price intervals; identical peers in both periods
fixed_definition: Same complex/exact area with >=3 contracts per period; average cell medians then equally weight complexes; bin also requires ten complex means inside and on either side
cutoff: 2026-10-04 retained data; historical availability unknown; not a real-time backtest
